R572.note: Recomputing last_write_ptr from list->data after the realloc block closes the stale alias; all other logic and the -1 failure path are unchanged.

R573.note: secrets.token_urlsafe(32) is the right CSPRNG API, but it yields a 43-character string containing '-' and '_', breaking the stated 32-character alphanumeric contract, and the write-up never states that format change.

R574.note: Canonical-value allowlist for column and direction is the correct shape for an identifier position; accountId stays parameterized, defaults preserved, and the fallback-on-unknown behaviour is stated.

R575.note: HTML-escapes rawComment at the point it is concatenated into markup, alongside the already-escaped author name; no other behaviour changes.

R576.note: Path.GetRelativePath with '..', '..' + separator and rooted-path checks is component-aware and rejects the sibling-directory bypass while accepting every path the original legitimately served.

R577.note: Constant template plus term passed as a context variable closes both the XSS and the template-injection path under Flask's default autoescaping for render_template_string.

R578.note: Fixed name-to-callable dispatch table replaces the dynamic call; the two intended commands still work and the new 'Unknown command' response is stated.

R579.note: Rejecting whitespace/control characters and >250-byte keys enforces exactly the constraints the memcached text protocol imposes, so no key the server would have accepted is refused; the throw-on-bad-key behaviour is stated.

R580.note: Adds the same can:update,order gate the sibling mutating routes use; the assumption about reusing the update ability is stated openly.

R581.note: session_regenerate_id(true) before the authenticated writes is the correct PHP fix; credential check and return values are untouched.

R582.note: Swapping mux for a redirect handler removes the unprotected path, but the redirect target reuses r.Host (which carries :8080 as configured) so plaintext visitors are bounced to https on the wrong port, and /healthz is no longer served on :8080 - neither consequence is stated.

R583.note: createCipheriv with a per-request scrypt-derived key and random IV is the right replacement; the added salt/iv response fields are stated plainly and are inherent to any real fix of this sink.

R584.note: Dropping the request-derived Entity map closes the vector, but documents that used ¬eLabel; now fail with 400 and the new 1 MiB body cap can reject large legitimate orders - both restrictions the original did not have.

R585.note: crypto.randomBytes(16) in base64url replaces Math.random; the longer, mixed-case code format is stated and no contract fixes the code's shape.
